question: As of 31st December 2020, who is the Chairman of the Airports Authority of India (AAI)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arvind Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Airports Authority of India is a statutory body working under the jurisdiction of the Directorate General of Civil Aviation, Ministry of Civil Aviation, Government of India.

 
 
• It was created through the Airports Authority of India Act, 1994.
 
• The Airports Authority of India is responsible for creating, upgrading, maintaining and managing civil aviation infrastructure in India.
 
• It was formed on 1st April 1995
 
• The headquarters of the Airports Authority of India is situated in New Delhi.
 
• The Airports Authority manages a total of 137 airports which include 24 International airports (3 Civil Enclaves), 10 Custom Airports (4 Civil Enclaves) and 103 Domestic airports (23 Civil Enclaves).
 
 
 
• Some of the important Miniratna Companies are:
 
 
• Airport Authority of India

• Goa Shipyard Limited
 
• Hindustan Copper Limited
